segments.script: [EN: Warm up.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say hello.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Xin chào.] [EN: How much?] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bao nhiêu?] [EN: One.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Một.] [EN: Three.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ba.] [EN: The polite yes.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Dạ.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Hai.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Two.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: You count more items. Listen.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: After three comes four.] [VI_F: Bốn.] [EN: This means four. It has a high, rising tone. Round your lips for this vowel.] [EN: Say four.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bốn.] [EN: Again.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bốn.] [EN: Five.] [VI_F: Năm.] [EN: This means five. It has a flat tone.] [EN: Say five.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Năm.] [EN: Again.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Năm.] [EN: Ten.] [VI_F: Mười.] [EN: This means ten. It has a falling tone. Start with relaxed lips, not rounded.] [EN: Say ten.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mười.] [EN: Again.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mười.] [EN: Now count from three.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ba, bốn, năm.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Drill. Four.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bốn.] [EN: Ten.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Mười.] [EN: Five.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Năm.] [EN: Address an older woman.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Chị.] [EN: Address a younger person.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Em.] [EN: Now reverse.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Mười.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Ten.] [EN: What does this mean?] [VI_F: Bốn.] [PAUSE 3s] [EN: Four.] [EN: Count one through five.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Một, hai, ba, bốn, năm.] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Listen at the cart.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [VI_F: Dạ, anh muốn mấy cái?] [VI_M: Dạ, bốn.] [VI_F: Bốn nha.] [VI_M: Dạ, cảm ơn chị.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Now you try. Say four.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Bốn.] [EN: Count three, four, five.] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: Ba, bốn, năm.] [EN: Good.] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Tomorrow you learn how to count things — measure words. The preview word is] [VI: cái] [EN: the general word for counting objects.]
